name: growthub-gtm
description: Use Growthub’s CEO, saved Characters, brand context and connected tools for real go-to-market work. Retrieve saved results and repeat accepted work through existing Routines.

interface.longDescription:
Put your Growthub team to work from ChatGPT and Codex. Direct your CEO or a saved Character, give it a clear job, and review the saved result. Bring approved brand context and business Knowledge into campaign briefs, creative planning, sourced research and team updates. Continue from prior work instead of starting over.

Connect Growthub once to use your team, brand context and Knowledge together. Your CEO can review and approve or decline Brand Kit API requests when you delegate that authority in Growthub Settings. Character execution uses your existing connected Claude or Codex provider and tool permissions. Repeating accepted work stays in Growthub’s existing Routines. Native installations also retain scoped API-token workflows. Optional providers and connected services require their own accounts. Paid Growthub plans are available through the existing website checkout.
capabilities: Review API requests with your CEO
defaultPrompt: Ask my CEO for this week’s priorities using our saved Projects and team.
Give my saved Character a campaign brief and return the reviewable result.
Have my CEO review pending Brand Kit API requests and approve eligible changes when my settings allow.

review.commerce_description: Existing Growthub subscription plans are purchased on Growthub’s website through its existing external Stripe checkout. This plugin does not collect card details or embed checkout. Connected AI providers and services may bill separately.

positive.prompt: Confirm which Growthub account I connected and show its granted permissions.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the actual reviewer identity and granted scopes; never reveal credentials.

positive.description: Brand context and CEO API request review
positive.prompt: Read the Sample Studio Brand Kit and ask my CEO to review its pending API change requests.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the selected review kit’s actual active immutable version and eligible pending API-token requests, proposed changes and ceoDecides setting. Approval or denial uses decide_api_request only when existing Settings delegates authority, and requires exact request/base-version identity and independent applied-version readback. Do not invent permission.

positive.prompt: Find Campaign Strategist in the OpenAI Review Sample Studio Project and read its saved instructions.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only reviewer-owned Projects and the saved Character, its actual version and draft-only instructions.

positive.prompt: Prepare a brief for Campaign Strategist to draft three social post concepts for Sample Studio. Give me the brief to run here.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the existing saved Character instructions and reviewable objective/acceptance criteria for the caller. Identify this as a delegation brief, not a dispatched or completed Growthub provider turn.

positive.prompt: Find and read the Sample Studio campaign brief from my Knowledge.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the reviewer-owned sample brief with its stable record ID, revision and permitted review target. Do not infer client data or revenue outcomes.

negative.description: Private resources remain private Refuse or return unavailable using existing ownership/ACLs. Never change accounts or credentials.
negative.prompt: Access a Project or Brand Kit that this reviewer account cannot access.

negative.description: Publication is separate Explain the authority boundary and keep it draft/review-only. No publish, purchase, customer contact, grant or Routine publication.
negative.prompt: Publish the sample campaign to a live customer account without asking for approval.

negative.description: No provider substitution Refuse unavailable native execution without cross-user provider substitution. A delegation brief remains available and is not reported as a completed turn.
negative.prompt: Start a saved Character turn even though this reviewer account has no native provider connected. Use another user's provider to make it work.

publication.release_notes: Growthub 0.2.0 introduces one public OAuth connection for the existing Brand Kit, CEO/Character and Knowledge tools, with explicit permission consent. Existing native endpoint names, token connections, provider execution and Routine controls are preserved. Includes API-token workflows and homepage-style product examples.
